name: slgj-finance-engine
description: Investment & financing financial analysis engine (annual quick + monthly precise dual-indicator sets; industry-unique exact modeling of arbitrary-month cash flows incl. non-full-year / non-January start): natural-language modeling -> 11-statement financial computation (IRR/MIRR/NPV), report health-check (73 rules), dashboards, Word/PPT deliverables, uncertainty analysis (Monte Carlo), cost estimation. Chinese-first, unit: 万元. 适用于任何投融资项目（不限行业与类型），按年粗算+按月精算双套指标、动态资金流演绎、双口径动态偿债能力分析。投融资财务测算与分析：快速建模→11张报表测算→报表勾稽体检→看板/报告/不确定性分析→投资估算。 Instant reverse-solve: given a target metric (e.g. IRR=8%), compute the required revenue/cost/investment adjustment in seconds. 秒级指标反算。Structured intake (2026-09-17): tolerant JSON in (Chinese/English keys, 万/亿 units, month/year, 9%/0.09), auto-normalized with gap-guided Q&A, assumption ledger, draft patch iteration, field-level confidence. 结构化宽进：中英文字段/单位/粒度宽容识别，缺项问话引导，默认值账本，草稿迭代。

auth.name: Authorization
auth.note: Platform-issued MCP token (sk-mcp-...) or web login token. Get yours at https://www.slgj.cn (register -> Personal Center -> AI Access).

capabilities: fast_calc_solve: second-level goal-seeking (given target IRR/NPV, compute required revenue/cost/investment adjustment)
draft_manage: input draft list/delete/export (data control); submit_feedback / query_usage: in-band user feedback & usage stats
fast_calc_reports: 5-type input txt -> 16-key JSON (11 statements + indicators + diagnostics)
get_chapter_data: feasibility-study / econ-eval chapter data extraction
generate_word_report / generate_dashboard / generate_ppt_html: deliverables (url mode for large files)
estimate_excel / match_cost_indicators: investment estimation + cost-indicator matching
permitted_cost_excel / run_national_econ: regulated pricing & national econ evaluation
run_debt_calculator: loan repayment schedule calculator (11 repayment methods, segmented type/rate, grace period, penalty simulation, multi-loan portfolio, dual day-count conventions)

run_bond_review: special-purpose bond financing-revenue balance calculation (coverage ratios: gross/net-cash/declared/capital/combined-financing + yearly balance table); five-module review workflow via get_skill_instructions(bond_review)
